description: Source code for a video decoder class implementing AV1 decoding using the AOM library, supporting decode-to-texture and decode-to-video frame output modes, with thread management and error handling.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles AV1 video decoding using the AOM library, managing codec initialization, decoding buffers, error reporting, and output frame management.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with specified codec and output mode.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of input stream to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, cancels pending jobs, and clears frames.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error message via callback.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the AOM AV1 decoder with specific configuration.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the decoder context and releases decode targets.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer and creates a video frame from the decoded data.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
